about: Controls the silent-controls audit must not activate as an ordinary press. Each entry matches a shown control by its chrome-string label key (resolved in the window's language; a {placeholder} matches any filling) or, when the control has no catalogue label, by a pattern over its accessible name. kind destructive or remote: the press must open a confirmation (a dialog or alertdialog), which the audit then cancels with Escape. kind external: the control hands off to the system (browser, folder) and is not pressed. kind window: native window chrome (minimise, maximise, restore), whose failures the title bar already reports; not pressed. kind session: the control ends the session the audit runs in and is not pressed; teardown signs out through it and requires the sign-in form. A Button with data-variant=destructive is treated as destructive without an entry.
